name: auxo-web
description: Offline-first browser/PWA version of the Auxo retail POS.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@auxo/core && npm run build --workspace=@auxo/app
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@auxo/core && npm run lint --workspace=@auxo/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@auxo/core && npm run typecheck --workspace=@auxo/app
